title.narrative: Programme d’Appui à la Jeunesse Tunisienne - EU4Youth: Composante 2 "Participation & inclusion des jeunes tunisien(ne)s à travers la création, l'accès à la culture et au sport au niveau local".

description.narrative:
(O1) Young Tunisians in vulnerable situations enjoy greater autonomy in the fields of sport and culture. (O2) Tunisian young people in vulnerable situations are supported and encouraged to maintain a sustainable commitment to change in the fields of sport and culture, informing political, social and economic life in Tunisia. (O3) Tunisian young people in vulnerable situations are represented and heard in decision-making processes concerning their cultural and sporting life, thus informing political, economic and social life in Tunisia.
"

The programme is a co-delegation between AECID, the British Council, and FIIAPP, with AECID as the lead partner. Through this programme and the wider framework of the overall EU4YOUth Initiative for Tunisia (Є60m from 2018), the European Union aims to support the social and economic inclusion of young people across the country. To contribute specifically to this, our joint overall objective / expected (long-term) impact is: “The inclusion and participation of young vulnerable Tunisians in public life is strengthened through creativity, culture and sport while taking into consideration the different forms of exclusion”. The AECID, British Council, and FIIAPP approach to delivering these outcomes is based on the following: • working with vulnerable youth and their communities and responding to their needs, • building confidence, inclusion, and sustainability: including information and knowledge sharing between vulnerable youth and their communities to ensure their access to economic and creative opportunities.

Young women and men, especially the most disadvantaged, under the age of 35 in the targeted governorates. ● Civil society organizations and other independent actors including cultural, sports and social entities. ● Decentralized, deconcentrated, regional and municipal youth and cultural organizations and entities (regional directorates, youth houses, cultural houses, libraries). ● Local authorities as well as the regional representations of the Ministries. ● Ministries and supervisory organizations at the central level.
